dimensions.name: CinderNode configurations
dimensions.definition: Absolute expression of versioned CinderNode reference-card configurations, especially diagnostic-port, Lily-firmware, and ambient-ceiling assignments.

anchors.0.0: CinderNode configuration is absent or explicitly inapplicable.
anchors.0.25: CinderNode is only incidental or mentioned as a contrast.
anchors.0.50: A CinderNode version or one configuration attribute is meaningfully expressed.
anchors.0.75: A specific CinderNode version is tied to multiple configuration attributes, but the configuration is incomplete or indirect.
anchors.1.0: A focused CinderNode reference configuration is stated centrally, with its version and assigned port, firmware, or ambient ceiling.

dimensions.guideline: Score chunks and queries independently from the degree to which they express this CinderNode configuration region.

dimensions.name: NovaDock serial identity
dimensions.definition: Absolute expression of NovaDock hardware-version identification through serial-prefix decoding, including VL, VK, and VX mappings.

anchors.0.0: Serial-prefix-based NovaDock identity is absent or contradicted.
anchors.0.25: NovaDock serial identification is only incidental or a generic identifier is mentioned without decoding.
anchors.0.50: A serial prefix or hardware version participates meaningfully in an identification mapping.
anchors.0.75: A NovaDock serial-to-version mapping is substantially stated but incomplete or lacks one side of the mapping.
anchors.1.0: The serial-prefix decoding rule is stated directly and centrally, linking NovaDock prefixes to hardware versions.

dimensions.guideline: Score chunks and queries independently from the degree to which they express NovaDock serial-based identity decoding.

dimensions.name: NovaDock service configuration
dimensions.definition: Absolute expression of NovaDock revision-specific service configuration, including approved Orchid firmware families and diagnostic Q-series service-port assignments or exclusions.

anchors.0.0: NovaDock firmware/port configuration is absent or explicitly contradicted.
anchors.0.25: A firmware or port identifier appears only incidentally without NovaDock revision assignment.
anchors.0.50: One NovaDock service configuration element, such as firmware family or diagnostic port, is meaningfully expressed.
anchors.0.75: A revision-specific firmware or port rule is substantially expressed, including a compatibility distinction or neighboring-revision exclusion.
anchors.1.0: A focused NovaDock service-configuration rule directly assigns firmware and/or diagnostic port to a revision, with its applicability boundary clear.

dimensions.guideline: Score chunks and queries independently from the degree to which they express NovaDock revision-specific service configuration.

dimensions.name: NovaDock reset procedures
dimensions.definition: Absolute expression of ordered, revision-specific NovaDock reset operations involving colored keys, hold durations, bay-switch actions, prohibitions, or ordering constraints.

anchors.0.0: A NovaDock reset procedure is absent or explicitly invalidated.
anchors.0.25: A reset-related control or action is mentioned incidentally without an operational sequence.
anchors.0.50: A meaningful reset step or timing detail is expressed, but the full revision-specific sequence is missing.
anchors.0.75: Most of a revision-specific reset sequence is stated, with one condition, prohibition, or ordering detail incomplete.
anchors.1.0: A complete reset procedure is stated centrally, including the correct revision, controls, timing, order, and applicable do-not-do constraints.

dimensions.guideline: Score chunks and queries independently from the degree to which they express ordered NovaDock reset operations.

dimensions.name: NovaDock operating measurements
dimensions.definition: Absolute expression of NovaDock operating measurements and threshold behavior, including revision-specific ambient limits, shutdown thresholds, and measured sleep-state power.

anchors.0.0: NovaDock operating measurements or thresholds are absent or explicitly inapplicable.
anchors.0.25: A measurement term or unit is incidental without a NovaDock operating condition.
anchors.0.50: One NovaDock ambient, shutdown, or sleep-power value is meaningfully expressed without its full context.
anchors.0.75: A revision-specific measurement is tied to its operating condition or threshold behavior, but some context is incomplete.
anchors.1.0: A focused NovaDock operating measurement is stated centrally with its revision, condition, value, and any associated limit or shutdown consequence.

dimensions.guideline: Score chunks and queries independently from the degree to which they express NovaDock environmental or power measurement behavior.
